affinity.notes: Muted flesh and earth colors imply physical corruption rather than a specific element.

anatomy.notes: The intentionally aberrant body is coherent: central head, radial stitched limbs, and occupied brood cavities are all legible.

archetype.notes: Perceived role "stationary tank and minion spawner" semantically communicates Cathedral-of-Corpses Sovereign (Sovereign) or its battlefield duty.

counterplay.notes: Its immobile bulk, radial reach, and visible cavity occupants clearly suggest spacing around a spawning tank.

finish.notes: Stitches, folds, cavities, and embedded figures are detailed without losing the main silhouette.

framing.notes: The wide crop suits the radial mass and keeps every major appendage inside frame.

identity.notes: Blind perception "stitched flesh mound or broodmother" semantically identifies rotwalkers/rotwalker-plague-lord.

tier.notes: Perceived tier "boss" is accepted for intended T5 under the documented v2 normalization.
